input.title: Staff Platform Engineer
input.descriptionText:
Northwind is a developer-tools company with a distributed team of 60.

The role
This is a fully remote role. You will lead the design of our multi-region platform, mentor engineers and take part in the on-call rotation.

Where you can work
You can work from anywhere as long as you are within UTC-3 to UTC+3, so that you have good overlap with the rest of the team.

What we're looking for
- Deep experience with Kubernetes and Terraform
- Experience operating distributed systems in production
